title: Is there a way to use searchFunction with react instantsearch?
body: The InstantSearch component doesn't appear to expose this option.

comments.body:
Hi, no but can you give me your usecase as for the need of a searchFunction like in react instantsearch? Maybe the already available API entries are sufficient.

Let me know.
I'd like to avoid performing an initial empty query.

React InstantSearch has been moved here: https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch
This issue has either been rewritten or placed inside our backlog.
